Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-b.

Sprint goal: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically. There are 5 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, on your earlier commitments, is story 3 done, is story 4 done, is task 19 done, and is task 15 done?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you—and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12, the Sandbox gateway timeouts on retry?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, and nothing is blocking you.

Task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, is past its due date. What is the new date?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: the reconciliation report is at risk, you’ll start it right after the idempotency keys, and you’ll flag it if it slips.

Daniel, story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock getting the idempotency keys in so you can resume the summary page?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel. Maya, for story 5, bug 12, and story 2, are those done?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline, I will add it to the parking lot; Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 with the sandbox gateway timing out and needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment to pair with him on the staging access today, and that staging access is blocking progress; blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 5 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and your commitment: the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review and you’ll chase them today, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.

Admin, is task 14 done, and is story 1 done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.
Task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
For the sandbox being down and delaying that work, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker: blocked on the sandbox with the platform team, and the commitment: will sync with Maya after the stand-up, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised, and we heard that story 3 is on track and will be picked up again once idempotency keys are in, bug 12 is blocked by sandbox gateway timeouts and a need for platform staging access, staging access is blocking progress, PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review, the sandbox was down, and there’s also a blocker with the platform team around the sandbox.

A side discussion between Daniel Park and Admin about gateway timeouts was parked for offline.

Task 15 is stale and wasn’t covered; the owners will get a follow-up, and nobody was absent or failed to respond.

Follow-ups, including any needed ones for attendance, are coming in Teams—thanks everyone.
